remediation.acceptanceCriteriaMissing: Add concrete and verifiable acceptance criteria to the configured Jira field.
remediation.acceptedStatusIncomplete: Complete the issue and move it to an accepted status.
remediation.approvalMarkerMissing: Obtain the required approval and then apply the configured label.
remediation.correctFixVersionVersionOnly: Enable the “Explicit JQL scope” mode if missing or incorrect version assignments need to remain visible.
remediation.correctFixVersionAssign: Assign the analyzed version in the Jira “Fix Version/s” field.
remediation.noBlockerLabelBlocked: Resolve the blocker and then remove the label.
remediation.noBlockingLinksBlocked: Resolve linked blockers or correct the Jira link if it is inaccurate.
remediation.noOpenSubtasksBlocked: Complete open subtasks or remove them from the release scope with appropriate justification.
